svg.desc: host-cpu-saturation on run anomaly_cpu_aggressive_steady_r1 (sockshop): fires. The gap between the nearest other fault and this one is 1.12x. This run measured 0.998 share of all cores on "host CPU at the busiest point"; the cut is at 0.95. The fault that comes closest to breaking this cut is noisy_neighbor on sockshop at 0.889. This number alone separates all 272 runs. Every gate together: 271 of 272 runs correct. host CPU reached capacity: pass (0.998 needs >= 0.95) FIRED host-cpu-saturation - host CPU reached 0.998 of capacity with stress-ng-cpu taking 6.4938 cores - no headroom left no cpu-contention-co-tenant - thief stress-ng-cpu 6.4938 cores, host 0.9983 - does not match a bounded co-tenant workload no db-latency-dependency-wait - the path is retransmitting 50.0% of segments across 2 interfaces - packets are being lost, so this is the network rather than the datastore no host-disk-saturation - disk arrivals per unit of interrupt rise 0, below the 450 bar no network-path-degradation - retransmission is 50.0% but nothing was dropped in the queue - the loss is happening in a receive buffer, not on the path, which is what an overloaded no service-cpu-throttle - utilisation ratio 1.801, thief 6.4938 cores, biggest loss -0.3724, runqueue 56.47x - not a quota holding work back no service-memory-cap - interrupt time 0.55x, below the 2.0 bar
